title: home-today
prompt:
Mobile home screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam". Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "1"/"2", blue #0039A6 "A"/"C", green #00843D "4"/"6", orange #FF6319 "B"/"D", yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N"/"R", purple #9B2A92 "7", lime #6CBE45 "G"); progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.
Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons, no emoji.
Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b, statute indigo #818cf8. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Every tap target at least 44pt. Floating glass capsule tab bar at the bottom with 6 tabs (icon over label): Home, Study, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.
Show only the top half of the home screen with a new "Today's plan" card placed directly under the countdown board. The countdown board: a 24-radius card holding a near-black inset board with route bullet, "NYS salesperson exam" and "Oct 14 & 15", and three big tabular cells "5" days "19" hours "41" minutes.
"Today's plan" card (18 radius, #111725): heading "Today's plan" with "2 of 4 done" right-aligned in secondary ink. Four checklist rows drawn as stations on a vertical subway line (filled green station = done, hollow ringed station = to do): 1. "Review 86 due flashcards" with a small "12 min" caption; 2. "Drill your weakest line: Real Estate Finance" with a route bullet green "4"; 3. "Read the Taxes & Assessments cram sheet" with a yellow "N" bullet; 4. "Take a timed mock exam" with caption "Last mock: 3 days ago". The first two are done (muted text with a check). Each row is tappable with a chevron. Below the card the existing green primary button "Quick 10-Question Drill".
